name: Memory External Reranker
description: OpenClaw memory reranker plugin that proxies to a Cohere-compatible /v1/rerank endpoint (Cohere, Jina, Voyage, llama.cpp).

provider.label: Provider
provider.help: Provider ID from models.providers in the OpenClaw config

model.label: Model
model.help: Reranker model id for the selected provider

modelFallbacks.label: Model Fallbacks
modelFallbacks.help: Ordered list of alternate model ids tried on failure

endpointPath.label: Endpoint Path
endpointPath.help: HTTP path appended to the provider baseUrl (default '/v1/rerank')

topN.label: Top N
topN.help: Maximum number of results returned by the rerank endpoint

additionalBodyParams.label: Additional Body Params
additionalBodyParams.help: Extra key/value pairs merged into the rerank request body

allowPrivateNetwork.label: Allow Private Network
allowPrivateNetwork.help: Set to true when the reranker endpoint is on a private or loopback host (e.g. localhost, 192.168.x.x). Restricts outbound access to the configured baseUrl hostname only.
